Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Petal Perfect Creations is a retail business specializing in the design, manufacture, and sale of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations include a physical storefront where customers can browse and purchase our unique floral arrangements and supplies. We also offer basic floral consultation services for customers seeking advice on arrangement styles and themes. Our inventory is securely stored in a climate-controlled space, ensuring the longevity and quality of our synthetic materials. During peak seasons, we implement enhanced inventory management practices to effectively handle increased demand. We prioritize customer safety and satisfaction and maintain robust fire protection measures throughout our facility. No high-risk activities are involved in our operations, and we have a proven track record of low claims history.
